title: Unpacking similarity effects in visual memory search: categorical, semantic, and visual contributions
authors: Linlin Shang, Lu-Chun Yeh, Yuanfang Zhao, Marius V. Peelen
venue: Journal of Memory and Language, 146, 104712 (preprint: bioRxiv 2025.04.09.647918)
caption_short: Procedures of (A) the long-term memory task: study phase, memory test until known, then single probes (target, same-category or other-category distractor; 200 ms, 1800 ms to respond); and (B) the short-term memory task: set shown at once (self-paced), red fixation, single probe, feedback.
